notes.subject: ומבשרי
notes.rationale: 'from my flesh' can mean 'in my flesh' (KJV: still alive in body) or 'without my flesh' (JPS: after the body is destroyed); Tok Pisin 'long mit bilong mi' keeps the ambiguity.

notes.subject: נקפו
notes.rationale: Rare verb — 'struck off / flayed / compassed'; rendered 'bagarapim' (destroyed), one of several possible pictures.

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Object pronoun supplied — Hebrew leaves the object of 'see' implicit until 'Eloa'.

translation: Na bihain, dispela skin bilong mi ol i bagarapim pinis, na long mit bilong mi mi bai lukim ⟨em⟩, Eloa.
